name: NREL 5MW
subtitle: Land-based · Class A · 5 MW
description: NREL offshore baseline 5 MW reference turbine configured for onshore operation. Hub height 90 m, rotor diameter 126 m. Industry-standard benchmark used in hundreds of publications.
notes: CompServo=0 (open-loop). To enable closed-loop ROSCO control: set CompServo=1 in NREL-5MW.fst — libdiscon.dylib, DISCON.IN, and Cp_Ct_Cq.NREL5MW.txt are already bundled in the model directory.
